name: Snipe
short: Your left click: instant 20 m hit that gives back 120 MP. Chains into Continuous Fire or Spiral Arrow.
desc: Deals damage to a target within 20 m and restores 120 MP.

name: Continuous Fire
short: Second hit of the left-click chain, option 1 of 2. Same 120 MP return as Snipe.
desc: Deals damage to a target within 20 m and restores 120 MP.

name: Spiral Arrow
short: The other second hit of the left-click chain, and the biggest mana return in the kit: 150 MP.
desc: Deals damage to a target within 20 m and restores 150 MP.

name: Rapid Fire
short: Your right click: 4-target cone filler you alternate with Snipe to cut recovery frames. 96 MP.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target up to 20 m away. Groggy gauge damage: 1.

name: Snare Arrow
short: The slow that switches half the class on: it gates Rupture Arrow, Explosive Arrow and the Binding Eye passive.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target up to 20 m away and slows them for 5 s with -40% movement speed. Groggy gauge damage: 10.

name: Target Arrow
short: Your Precision upkeep (+300 critical, 7 s). Feeds Aimed Shot's +35% and gates Suppression Arrow. Global name: Marking Shot.
desc: Deals damage to a target within 20 m. You move in the direction you are holding and enter Precision for 7 s. Precision: +300 critical. Groggy gauge damage: 7.

name: Drilling Dart
short: Fires only on a critical. Returns 100 MP and applies a 6 s bleed with -50% healing received: your anti-heal tool.
desc: On a critical hit, deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target up to 20 m away and restores 100 MP. The target bleeds for 6 s: damage every second and -50% healing received. Only one of the three healing-reduction effects applies at a time. Groggy gauge damage: 5.

name: Arrow Barrage
short: Only fires against a groggy target. Free, instant, and the most argued-over skill in the kit.
desc: Deals damage to a groggy target within 20 m.

name: Gale Arrow
short: Charge skill that puts you in Gale for 10 s: +7% combat speed. Your combat-speed buff.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target up to 20 m away and puts you in Gale for 10 s. Gale: +7% combat speed. Groggy gauge damage: 10.

name: Explosive Trap
short: Trap at your feet, 10 s armed, 3 s stun at 40% (100% on NPCs). The target must be in your line of sight when it goes off.
desc: Places an area trap near you. The trap lasts 10 s and, when an enemy approaches, deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 5 m and stuns them for 3 s with a 40% chance. Against NPCs the stun lands 100% of the time. Groggy gauge damage: 10.

name: Rupture Arrow
short: Only fires against a slowed or bound target: Snare Arrow's payoff. Always sits below the slow in the macro.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a slowed or bound target up to 20 m away. Groggy gauge damage: 15.

name: Suppression Arrow
short: Only fires while you are in Precision. 3 s stun at 40% (100% on NPCs). It roots you: a PvP tool, a PvE trap.
desc: Deals damage to a target within 20 m while you are in Precision and stuns it for 3 s with a 40% chance. Against NPCs the stun lands 100% of the time. Groggy gauge damage: 10.

name: Aimed Shot
short: The biggest hit in the kit: 3-stage charge, +35% damage while in Precision. Full charge, never in a macro. Global name: Dead Shot.
desc: Deals damage to a target within 20 m. If you are in Precision, the damage increases by 35%. Maximum 3 charge stages. Groggy gauge damage: 10 to 16.

name: Shock Release
short: Your only real defensive: cleanses stun, knockdown, air-bind, grab, freeze and fear, then 5 s of status immunity.
desc: Removes your stun, knockdown, air-bind, grab, freeze and fear states and puts you in Resolute for 5 s. Resolute: immunity to status effects.
rank20: The cooldown drops from 1 min to 41 s.

name: Lightning Arrow
short: Shock Release's chain, not a loose skill: a guaranteed 3 s stun at 20 m right after you break a control.
desc: Deals damage to a target within 20 m and stuns it for 3 s.
rank20: The cooldown drops from 2 min to 1 min 22 s.

name: Vigilant Eye
short: The Ranger's PvP passive: +200 evasion, +6% max HP, and evading restores HP.
desc: Your evasion increases by 200 and your max HP by 6%, and a successful evade restores HP. Internal cooldown: 3 s.

name: Focused Barrage
short: Extra damage 50% of the time against targets already taking damage over time. Turns Griffon's Arrow and the bleed into more than a tick.
desc: Against targets taking damage over time, 50% chance of dealing extra damage. Internal cooldown: 1 s.
rank20: No visible change: the database publishes no damage figure.

name: Wind's Vitality
short: +15 max stamina, and every hit you take gives +10% movement speed for 1 s. The rank curve here is brutal.
desc: Your max stamina increases by 15 and every time you take a hit your movement speed rises 10% for 1 s. Internal cooldown: 5 s.
rank20: +300 stamina and +29% movement speed for 2.8 s.

name: Eye of Focus
short: The first passive in every queue: +100 accuracy, +1% PvE, +0.5% PvP, +0.2% Smite. Global name: Focused Eye.
desc: Your accuracy increases by 100, your PvE damage amplification by 1%, your PvP by 0.5% and your Smite by 0.2%.
rank20: +20% PvE, +10% PvP and +4% Smite. This is where the class's real scaling lives.

name: Hunter's Resolve
short: +6% critical damage amplification. Second in the PvE queue, deprioritised in PvP.
desc: Your critical damage amplification increases by 6%.
rank20: Critical damage amplification goes from +6% to +25%.

name: Resolve of Resistance
short: +11.5% physical and shock resistance: pure anti-chain-control. Lock it on your Abyss accessories.
desc: Your physical and shock resistance increase by 11.5%.
rank20: Physical and shock resistance go from +11.5% to +40%.

name: Binding Eye
short: Extra damage 50% of the time against slowed or bound targets: Snare Arrow's third payoff.
desc: Against slowed or bound targets, 50% chance of dealing extra damage on hit. Internal cooldown: 1 s.
rank20: No visible change: the database publishes no damage figure.

name: Close-Range Shot
short: Rewards fighting at range: 25% extra damage beyond 5 m, and only an occasional knockback up close.
desc: On a hit within 5 m, 5% chance to knock the target back; on a hit beyond 5 m, 25% chance of extra damage. Internal cooldown: 1 s.
rank20: No visible change: the database publishes no damage figure.

name: Contract of Recovery
short: +17% status resistance, stacking while you are controlled, plus an automatic 35% heal below 10% HP.
desc: Your status resistance increases by 17% and, while stunned, knocked down, air-bound, frozen or feared, every hit you take grants +10% status resistance for 5 s, stacking 10 times. Below 10% HP you instantly restore 35% of max HP. Internal cooldowns: 1 min heal, 1 s resistance.

name: Hunter's Soul
short: On a critical, 50% chance of extra damage. Baizel's Authority multiplies its effect by 1.5.
desc: On a critical, 50% chance of dealing extra damage. Internal cooldown: 1 s.
rank20: No visible change: the database publishes no damage figure.

name: Arrow Storm
short: Stigma. 4-target AoE with a 50% stun (100% on NPCs) and the biggest groggy contribution in the kit: 50.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target up to 20 m away and stuns them for 3 s with a 50% chance. Against NPCs the stun lands 100% of the time. Groggy gauge damage: 50.

name: Baizel's Authority
short: Stigma. +20% attack power for 10 s, and it multiplies Hunter's Soul and Focused Barrage by 1.5 while it lasts.
desc: For 10 s, your attack power increases by 20%.
rank20: The duration goes from 10 s to 20 s.

name: Blessing of the Bow
short: Stigma. +200 critical for 10 s.
desc: For 10 s, your critical increases by 200.
rank20: The duration goes from 10 s to 20 s.

name: Ambush Kick
short: Stigma. Teleports you behind a target within 5 m, knocks it back and sends you backwards: your disengage.
desc: You move behind a target within 5 m, deal damage and knock it back. You then move backwards.

name: Binding Trap
short: Stigma. Trap armed for 30 s that air-binds up to 4 enemies for 3 s with no chance roll.
desc: Places an area trap near you. The trap lasts 30 s and, when an enemy approaches, deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 5 m and air-binds them for 3 s. Groggy gauge damage: 20.

name: Phantom Arrow
short: Stigma. Single-target hit that blinds for 3 s.
desc: Deals damage to a target within 20 m and blinds it for 3 s.

name: Stealth
short: Stigma. 10 s of stealth, out of combat only: it breaks the moment you enter combat.
desc: Puts you in stealth for 10 s. Cannot be used in combat, and the effect is cancelled if you enter combat after activating it.

name: Seal Arrow
short: Stigma. 75% chance to seal the target for 5 s (100% on NPCs): it locks the target's skills.
desc: Deals damage to a target within 20 m and seals it for 5 s with a 75% chance. Against NPCs the seal lands 100% of the time. Groggy gauge damage: 20.

name: Nature's Breath
short: Stigma. -20% damage from players for 10 s plus a 25% chance to heal 30% of what you take. Global name: Mother Nature.
desc: For 10 s, damage you take from players is reduced by 20%, and you gain Nature: a 25% chance to restore 30% of the damage taken as HP. Not affected by effects that increase cooldowns.
rank20: The cooldown drops from 1 min 30 s to 52 s.

name: Griffon's Arrow
short: Stigma. 10 s of Crimson Flame: fire damage every second that grows while the target is moving. A PvP kiting tool.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target up to 20 m away and puts them in Crimson Flame for 10 s. Crimson Flame: fire damage every second, and the damage over time increases while the target is moving. Groggy gauge damage: 20.

name: Explosive Arrow
short: Stigma. 4-target AoE that hits 20% harder if the target is slowed or bound: another Snare Arrow payoff.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target up to 20 m away. If the target is slowed or bound, the damage increases by 20%.

name: Assault Strike
short: Stigma. 4-target AoE with a 30% stun that also gives you up to +20% defence, scaling with how many you hit.
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target up to 20 m away and stuns them for 3 s with a 30% chance. Against NPCs the stun lands 100% of the time. Your defence increases by up to 20% in proportion to the number of targets hit.

name: Supporting Fire
short: Stigma. A 15 s orb that fires on its own with a 25% chance and drains 1.5% HP per shot: your solo sustain.
desc: For 15 s, summons an orb around you that provides supporting fire. The orb fires with a 25% chance, deals damage and absorbs 1.5% HP. Firing cooldown: 0.5 s.
